session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Up, Bull Trend Resumption from Open' (ET+12 hrs, May 6/7). Bull trend from the open in a tight bull channel (7330 to 7372), magenta wedge 'do not sell', double top after 2 legs up got low probability aggressive sells, tight trading range at the EMA (bar 36) and a wedge double bottom with 2 legs down bear trap (low 7358), then midday trend resumption in a bull micro channel (buy for any reason), a midday range measured move (7368-7381) and yet another all-time high 7396/7398 with limit order trading into the close 7394. Inset: relentless bull trend resumption to new high.
